name: Urami
source:
A message from Miyako:

Love is such a wonderful thing, wouldn’t you agree? But it can also be quite horrible and unfair. Which do you prefer? The playful innocence of puppy love or something a bit more realistic? I prefer the former. It’s much less complicated. Much less disheartening.  

Oh, but look at me being all depressing! Let me introduce myself. My name is Miyako Saito. Welcome to my game. I’m sure we’ll get along just fine~

[From [url=https://amethyscent.itch.io/urami]itch.io[/url]]
